"""One-shot, own-job affinity correction and scheduler-only drain; never cancel EDA."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,signal,socket,time

b=Path('/public/home/yuzelu/project-circuit/LLMHardwareDesign/issue-121')
run=b/'block-v1-20261027-207';raw=(run/'node-queue.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='90b4429c1657f347880be31a891db1e7eaa577d8f5a13d34e8ebf774f98c6400'
state=json.loads((run/'node-queue-state.json').read_text())
active={k:v for k,v in state['tasks'].items()if v['status']=='RUNNING'}
assert set(active)=={'s-drc','s-formal'},active
owner=active['s-drc']['owner'];assert all(v['owner']==owner and v['cpus']==16 for v in active.values())
assert owner['job_id']==os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID']=='92488'
assert owner['node']==socket.gethostname()=='node25'and os.environ['SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK']=='1'
pid=owner['pid'];parent=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
args=[x.decode()for x in(parent/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')if x]
assert args[-4:]==[str(run/'src/project/experiments/block_v1/worker.py'),str(run/'src'),'native-node-queue','96']
status=dict(x.split(':',1)for x in(parent/'status').read_text().splitlines()if ':'in x)
assert int(status['Uid'].split()[0])==os.getuid()
assert not(int(status['SigIgn'],16)&2)and(int(status['SigCgt'],16)&2)
control=b/'drain-control-20261028-0052/drain-control.json';c=json.loads(control.read_text())
assert c['passed']and c['existing_subprocess_completed']
assert hashlib.sha256((run/'src/project/experiments/block_v1/native_node_queue.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c['scheduler_sha256']
allowed=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(pid));assert len(allowed)==96
children=[]
for thread in(parent/'task').iterdir():children+=list(map(int,(thread/'children').read_text().split()))
workers={}
for child in set(children):
 q=Path('/proc')/str(child);a=[v.decode()for v in(q/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')if v]
 if len(a)>=3 and a[-3]==str(run/'src')and a[-2]in ('five-macro-drc-s','five-macro-formal-s')and a[-1]=='16':workers[a[-2]]=child
assert set(workers)=={'five-macro-drc-s','five-macro-formal-s'},workers

def tree(root):
 todo=[root];seen=set();rows=[]
 while todo:
  p=todo.pop()
  if p in seen:continue
  seen.add(p);q=Path('/proc')/str(p)
  try:
   assert 'job_92488'in(q/'cgroup').read_text()
   for thread in(q/'task').iterdir():
    tid=int(thread.name);rows.append(dict(pid=p,tid=tid,cpus=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(tid))))
    todo+=list(map(int,(thread/'children').read_text().split()))
  except ProcessLookupError:pass
 return rows

request=run/'operator-affinity-drain-20261028.json'
record=dict(time=time.time(),owner=owner,parent_args=args,queue_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
 state_before=state,control_sha256=hashlib.sha256(control.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),workers={},
 reason='Live own-job observation found kepler-formal96 threads: OMP_NUM_THREADS16 is not a hard CPU limit. Bind existing DRC/formal to separate16CPU masks, drain only old scheduler new claims, preserve all EDA and immutable inputs. Future peers must use taskset-bound scheduler and original claim locks.')
for i,mode in enumerate(sorted(workers)):
 record['workers'][mode]=dict(pid=workers[mode],mask=allowed[i*16:(i+1)*16],before=tree(workers[mode]))
with request.open('x')as stream:json.dump(record,stream,indent=2)
for mode,row in record['workers'].items():
 # Main worker first, so future exec/fork descendants inherit the mask.
 os.sched_setaffinity(row['pid'],row['mask'])
 for observation in tree(row['pid']):
  try:os.sched_setaffinity(observation['tid'],row['mask'])
  except ProcessLookupError:pass
 row['after']=tree(row['pid'])
 assert row['after']and all(set(v['cpus'])==set(row['mask'])for v in row['after'])
record['affinity_applied']=time.time();request.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
os.kill(pid,signal.SIGINT)
record.update(scheduler_only_sigint=time.time(),signalled_pid_only=pid)
request.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(request),scheduler_pid=pid,workers={k:dict(pid=v['pid'],mask=v['mask'],threads_checked=len(v['after']))for k,v in record['workers'].items()},no_eda_cancelled=True),indent=2))

"""One-shot affinity correction of an existing own-task R/V route tree."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,socket,sys,time
kind=sys.argv[1];number,job,node={'r':('196','92462','node26'),'v':('203','92475','node23')}[kind]
b=Path('/public/home/yuzelu/project-circuit/LLMHardwareDesign/issue-121')/('block-v1-20261027-'+number)
state=json.loads((b/'node-queue-state.json').read_text());entry=state['tasks'][kind+'-route'];owner=entry['owner']
assert entry['status']=='RUNNING'and entry['cpus']==16
assert owner['job_id']==job==os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID']and owner['node']==socket.gethostname()==node
assert os.environ['SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK']=='1'
pid=owner['pid'];parent=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
args=[x.decode()for x in(parent/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')if x]
assert args[-4:]==[str(b/'src/project/experiments/block_v1/worker.py'),str(b/'src'),'native-node-queue','96']
allowed=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(pid));assert len(allowed)==96
mask=allowed[:16];children=[]
for t in(parent/'task').iterdir():children+=list(map(int,(t/'children').read_text().split()))
workers=[];mode='five-macro-route-'+kind
for p in set(children):
 a=[x.decode()for x in(Path('/proc')/str(p)/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')if x]
 if a[-3:]==[str(b/'src'),mode,'16']:workers.append(p)
assert len(workers)==1,workers
worker=workers[0]
def tree():
 todo=[worker];seen=set();rows=[]
 while todo:
  p=todo.pop()
  if p in seen:continue
  seen.add(p);d=Path('/proc')/str(p)
  try:
   assert 'job_'+job in(d/'cgroup').read_text()
   status=dict(x.split(':',1)for x in(d/'status').read_text().splitlines()if ':'in x)
   assert int(status['Uid'].split()[0])==os.getuid()
   for t in(d/'task').iterdir():
    tid=int(t.name);rows.append(dict(pid=p,tid=tid,cpus=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(tid))))
    todo+=list(map(int,(t/'children').read_text().split()))
  except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError):pass
 return rows
p=b/'operator-affinity-20261028.json'
r=dict(time=time.time(),owner=owner,worker=worker,mode=mode,mask=mask,before=tree(),
 queue_sha256=hashlib.sha256((b/'node-queue.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 scope='Only CPU affinity of verified live own-job16CPU route and descendants; no signal, cancellation, restart or source/geometry/constraints change.')
with p.open('x')as f:json.dump(r,f,indent=2)
os.sched_setaffinity(worker,mask)
for observation in tree():
 try:os.sched_setaffinity(observation['tid'],mask)
 except ProcessLookupError:pass
r['after']=tree();assert r['after']and all(x['cpus']==mask for x in r['after'])
r['finished']=time.time();p.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(p),job_id=job,worker=worker,mask=mask,threads_checked=len(r['after']),no_signal=True)))
